Menu CO₂e Dashboard

Where does a serving's CO₂e come from?

Based on one adult serving in a workplace cafeteria. Change the dish to calculate any menu.

How much CO₂e does swapping one dish save?

Pick the current dish and its replacement. Dishes outside the list are calculated from their (Korean) name.

Monthly Menu

The slider settings are applied to the 4-week baseline menu (20 lunches). The calendar shows which dishes change and each lunch's CO₂e.

Annual CO₂e Dashboard

Move the sliders to recalculate cumulative annual emissions and emissions by food group. Settings are shared with the Monthly Menu.

How much annual CO₂e can our cafeteria cut?

Move the sliders below and everything recalculates instantly. The 4-week sample menu is assumed to repeat all year, at one adult workplace serving per diner.

CO₂e accumulated over a year

Where does the CO₂e come from?

How does this calculator work?

From a menu name alone to one serving's CO₂e, then scaled up to the whole cafeteria and a full year.
